screens.name: Co-Sign & Amendment Queue
screens.notes: CORRECTED 23-Sep-2026: the note-content render is NOT gated on canCosign in the component, but the path is unreachable — GET /notes/cosign-queue requires note:cosign:assigned, so a caller without it gets a 403 and the screen short-circuits before any markup. NOT a live leak; it is a defence-in-depth gap that becomes one the moment the route is relaxed to NoteReadAssigned (which S-06-09's 'other half' wants). The !canCosign banner is dead code. Amendment half still absent.

screens.name: Template & Order-Set Manager
screens.notes: FIXED 23-Sep-2026: template creation was 100% broken — the client category <select> and the server zod enum were disjoint, so every save 400'd. Both now share one set, covered by template-save.spec.ts. Undebounced resize replaced? NO — still window.innerWidth. OUTSTANDING: effective-dated versioning is modelled but NOT implemented on write (server does upsert.update; key is @unique so two rows cannot share a key). UI copy corrected to stop claiming it. Real fix needs a composite unique on key+effectiveFrom.
